items.title: AI triage algorithms yield varied results in real-world use
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: University of Washington evaluated staged system-wide deployment of multiple AI triage tools across 742,000+ imaging exams. Turnaround fell 76% for endotracheal tube malposition, 53% for rib fracture and 29% for vessel occlusion, but PE and intracranial hemorrhage saw no improvement.

items.title: AI may not improve patient outcomes for stroke
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: Northwell/Hofstra compared 876 acute ischemic stroke patients before and after five AI tools were introduced at a comprehensive stroke center; no significant change in good functional outcome at discharge, though CT angiography within 60 minutes rose sharply.

items.title: AI shines as worklist prioritization tool in detecting PE
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: Northwell study of 90,000+ CTPA exams found an FDA-cleared AI that bumps PE-positive scans up the worklist correctly reprioritized 84% with <1% false-positive elevation, cutting wait times ~41 minutes in resident workflows; no effect for attending-only reads.

items.title: Pharmaceutical advertising and drug recommendations by consumer-facing artificial intelligence: a controlled study
items.excerpt: Controlled study: injecting pharmaceutical advertising shifted LLM treatment selection toward the promoted drug while guideline concordance stayed high, so the shifts could evade correctness checks; the advertising influence was often undisclosed.
